rv.q: The house might have been built for him, but Alexander McQueen is not at home.
Unfortunately, despite the first-class production, House of McQueen never quite comes to dramatic life.
These efforts pay off in visual splendor. Yet, in part because of the great inherent promise of its subject, “House of McQueen” feels mostly like a missed opportunity.
House of McQueen is mostly a house of cards.
